response.justification: Bogdan brings 15+ years of broad software development experience and genuine developer-tooling depth — he authored a D test runner (Trial), an assertion library (Fluent-Asserts), set up GitLab/CI/deploy infrastructure, and has taught test automation courses — which maps well to the engineering productivity focus. However, the resume shows no people-management experience: every title is an individual-contributor role (Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Founder of a small OSS project), with no evidence of direct reports, performance reviews, hiring, or leading organizational change. The mobile-platform exposure is thin (some iOS/tvOS work a decade ago), and the tooling work is largely in a niche ecosystem (D) rather than at the scale of a large mobile platform. He is a plausible candidate for a senior IC or tech-lead track role, but does not currently meet the core people-leadership bar for a Level II Manager.
strengths: Deep, hands-on developer-tooling and test-infrastructure background (test runner, assertion library, CI/CD, DevOps)
15+ years across web, mobile, desktop, embedded — strong breadth for system design and code review
Demonstrated mentoring/knowledge-sharing via workshops, dojos, and a multi-module Selenium course
concerns: No documented people-management experience or direct reports (2-year minimum unmet)
No evidence of formal technical leadership scope, roadmap ownership, or organizational change leadership
Limited and dated mobile-platform experience; tooling work concentrated in a niche language ecosystem

key_factors.factor: Developer tools and testing infrastructure expertise
Unclear technical leadership scope / no roadmap ownership
